title: Filter agent environment
responsibility: Copy environment variables while removing provider credentials and the Electron Node-mode flag.

inputs.name: scrubEnvironment.env
inputs.description: Environment-variable map to filter. When omitted, the function uses process.env; each value is a string or undefined.

outputs.name: scrubEnvironment
outputs.description: A new environment map containing the input's enumerable own string-keyed entries except keys starting with OPENAI_ or ANTHROPIC_, keys matching /^(CLOUDFLARE_|CF_|WRANGLER_|HARNESS_.*(?:TOKEN|SECRET|KEY))/, and the exact key ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE. Matching is case-sensitive, and all remaining entries and values are copied unchanged.
